meta.name: autoskill
meta.description: Analyzes user-requested Screenpipe history windows to detect repeated research workflows, match existing scientific skills, and stage new skill drafts or composition recipes for review. Requires a reachable Screenpipe HTTP API, normally on localhost:3030. Detection and embedding inference run locally; the selected LLM receives redacted app/title cluster summaries and matched skill descriptions. Use only when the user explicitly asks to analyze their recent work and propose skills.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析你近期的屏幕使用记录,把反复出现的工作流程整理成可复用的技能草稿。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常做重复的调研工作,想把它们沉淀成可复用的技能。
copy.tagline_en: Turn repeated workflows from your recent screen history into skill drafts for review.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you repeat similar research tasks and want them captured as reusable skills.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会读取本机 screenpipe 记录的屏幕历史,把重复出现的工作流归成簇,与已有技能比对后,生成可审阅的新技能草稿或组合配方。检测和向量比对都在本机完成。
howto.when: 当你明确要求分析最近的工作并据此提出技能建议时触发,例如「分析我最近一天,提出新技能」。它只读本机 screenpipe(默认 localhost:3030),连不上就拒绝运行。

say.text: 分析我最近一天的工作,告诉我哪些流程还没被现有技能覆盖
say.note: 会生成 report.md 和草稿目录

say.text: 先加 --plan 跑一遍,让我看看将要分析的时间线
say.note: 干跑模式:聚类后即停,不调用 LLM

howto.what_en: After install, Claude reads your local screenpipe screen history, clusters repeated workflows, compares them against existing skills, and drafts reviewable new skill files or composition recipes. Detection and embedding run locally.
howto.when_en: Triggered only when you explicitly ask it to analyze your recent work and propose skills. It reads only the local screenpipe daemon (default localhost:3030) and refuses to run if unreachable.

say_en.text: Analyze my last day and tell me which workflows no existing skill covers
Run with --plan so I can see the timeline first
say_en.note: Dry run: stops after clustering, no LLM call

say_en.text: Promote the zotero-pubmed-helper draft into the skills folder
